notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
Rogue Slash is already released.

In last few days I fixed a lot of bugs (physics related), added support for controllers and made the game loading faster. It should now auto-detect your PC spec and adjust graphics settings before first run.

I spend a fun time creating it, I hope you will have fun playing it! 
I will not have access to the computer to 06.05.2019 but I will read your feedback on the phone and create a list of important features for you.

Have fun and help me improving Rogue Slash!
